## Memory Navigation Status

Status: Accepted with constraints

Criteria to remain top-level:

- Clear boundary from LifeModel.
- Clear boundary from 审核中心.
- Clear boundary from 工作区 evidence drawer.
- Not a raw memory database browser.
- First version has enough user value without becoming a heavy knowledge base.

Fallback:

- LifeModel sub-surface, or
- Settings / Data Management sub-surface.

## Surface Definitions

For each surface include:

- Purpose
- User question answered
- Current route mapping
- Default visible data
- Hidden/advanced data
- Source of truth
- What it must not do
- Key scenarios

## Current Route → V2 Surface Migration Matrix

| Current page / route | V2 destination | Preserve | Migrate | Remove / hide | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Today | 今日 | daily summary | pending review summary | old dashboard noise | data source inconsistency |
| ChatPage | 工作区 / 高级检查 | goal + execution | trace / diagnostics split out | raw default display | responsibility overload recurrence |
| CompanionPage | 工作区 | entry mental model | merge | independent companion shell | user migration cognition |
| Mailbox | 审核中心 | review items | permissions / proposals | mailbox naming | insufficient state machine |
| Runs | 任务 | run history | user-facing naming | developer-first labels | technical terms remain |
| LifeModel | LifeModel | projection | evidence layering | raw domain mixed reads | trust explanation |
| Memory | 记忆 / LifeModel sub-surface | search/lifecycle | status explanation | database browser feel | overlap with LifeModel/Review |
| Settings | 设置 | configuration | advanced inspection downshift | diagnostic junk drawer | hierarchy confusion |
